998V: Savaiye uttered in praise of Guru Angad Dev ji.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Second Mehl:
Saways in praise of the 2nd Guru.
Now those same Vedas, in the form of the Bhatts, utter the praise of Sri Guru Angad Sahib, the Second Patshahi:
E4ZR: Akal Purakh is One, and is found through the True Guru's grace.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By the True Guru's grace, is He obtained.
PT6J: Purakh = the all-pervading Hari. Kaaran karan = the cause of creation, the Creator of creation. Samratho = mighty, master of all powers.
Blessed is that Creator, the all-pervading Hari, who is the root cause of this creation, its Maker, and all-powerful.
Blessed is the Primal Lord God, the Creator, the All-powerful Cause of causes.
Blessed is He, the Creator Lord Master, who is Omnipotent to do all deeds.
Blessed is that Creator-Being, able to make the lords such as Brahma — Brahma being the maker of the great principle and the other causes of the whole world.
M9RT: Masatak tum = on your forehead (O Guru Angad!). Jin = which (Guru Nanak).
Blessed is the True Guru Nanak, who (O Guru Angad!) placed (his) hand on your forehead.
Blessed is the True Guru Nanak, who placed His hand upon Your forehead.
Blessed is Nanak, the True Guru, who has placed his hand on your brow, O Guru Angad.
That very form, Sri True Guru Nanak Sahib ji, has become worthy of praise, who placed his hand on your forehead.
NM9W: Amiu = amrit. Vuthau = rained down. Chhaj = in torrents, pouring. Bohiy = were drenched, soaked, made fragrant. Agaaj = openly, visibly.

Then, quite naturally, (Guru Nanak) placed his hand on (your) forehead. The Name-amrit rained down in torrents (in your heart), through whose blessing gods, humans, the ganas and sages and rishis were openly drenched.
When He placed His hand upon Your forehead, then the celestial nectar began to rain down in torrents; the gods and human beings, heavenly heralds and sages were drenched in its fragrance.
When Guru Nanak placed his hand on your forehead, then the Divine Nectar began to rain in torrents (van-loads), and the gods, men, heavenly heralds and sages were manifestly perfumed.

When that Sri True Guru placed his hand on your forehead, then quite naturally he (vuthau) rained down the amrit of teaching; You (chhaj) shone because of it; and through that same Name-amrit, the (gan) host of (sur) gods, (nar) humans and sages all became (agaaj) manifestly (bohiy) fragrant — or filled with dignity — in the form of glory.
AP7Y: Kantak = thorn (that is, painful). Garaj = roaring, showing one's strength. Dhaavat = wandering. Baraj leeo = held back. Panch bhoot = the five, lust and the rest. Samaj = gathering together, collecting (in Sanskrit 'samaj' means to gather, and from it comes the noun 'samaaj').
(O Guru Angad!) Showing your strength, you destroyed painful death, held back your own mind from wandering, and, gathering the five such as lust in one place, brought them under control.
You challenged and subdued the cruel demon of death; You restrained Your wandering mind; You overpowered the five demons and You keep them in one home.
Challenging, you destroyed the agonising death, restrained your wandering mind and controlling the five demons kept them in your one home.

You roared and killed the (kantak) painful enemy, death, and held back the mind from running among thoughts. And the five demons such as lust, which were (samaj) — sam + aj, wholly unconquered — you kept in the one house of the heart; meaning, you restrained them.
J5PG: Jeetau = has conquered. Gurduaar = at the Guru's door (falling). Samat = seeing all with one vision. Saar = the piece (in a board game). Samat saar = the game of equality. Khelahi = you play. Liv rath = the chariot of absorption, the flow of attention. Unman = in the state of 'unman', in full bloom. Raakh = keeping, by keeping. Nirankaar = in Akal Purakh.

(O Guru Angad!) Falling at the door of the Guru (Nanak), you have conquered the world; you are playing the game of equality (that is, you see all with one vision). Because you keep your absorption in the Formless One, the flow of your attention stays settled in the state of full bloom.
Through the Guru's Door, the Gurdwara, You have conquered the world; You play the game even-handedly. You keep the flow of your love steady for the Formless Lord.
Through Guru Nanak, you have conquered the world, you play the game of equality and keep fixed the flow of your steady love in the formless Lord.

Taking the teaching through the Guru, you have conquered the world; so you are playing the (saar) game of equality, for you have kept the (rath) flow of the mind's attention in the Formless One, the (unman) state beyond the three.
KVKD: Keerat = glory. Kal Sahaar = O Kalsahar! Sapat deep majhaar = in the seven continents (that is, in the whole world). Lahna keerat = Lahna's glory. Jagatr gur = the Guru of the world (Guru Nanak Dev ji). Paras = touching. Muraar = Guru Nanak, the form of Muraari (Mur-ar). ||1||
O Kalsahar! Say: by touching the Guru of the world (Nanak Dev ji), the form of Hari (that is, by falling at Guru Nanak's feet), Lahna's glory is spreading through the whole world. ||1||
O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||1||
O Kalsahar, throughout the seven continents, recite you the praise of Lehna, who meeting with his Lord, became the Guru of the world.

Sri Kalsahar ji says: by (paras) meeting Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji, the form of Muraari, Sri Lahna ji has become Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, the Guru of the whole world within the seven continents. So, O mind, (kahu) speak — that is, utter — the glory of such a True Guru. ||1||
D5FN: Ja kee = whose (Guru's). Amritdhaar drist = a glance that rains amrit. Kaalukh = the blackness of sins. Khan = digging up. Khan utaar = able to uproot and remove. Timar = darkness. Jaahi = are removed. Daras duaar = by the vision of (whose) door.
(Guru Angad Dev ji,) whose glance rains amrit and is able to uproot and remove the blackness (of sins) — by the vision of his door, the darknesses of ignorance and the like are removed.
The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar from His eyes washes away the slime and filth of sins; the sight of His door dispels the darkness of ignorance.
Such is Guru Angad, the ambrosial stream of whose glance washes off and removes the smut of sins and the sight of whose door, dispels the darkness of ignorance.

Whose glance is like a stream of amrit; it (khan) uproots and removes the blackness of sins. And by whose vision the (timar) darkness of ignorance is removed; meaning, by seeing him the mind becomes happy.
F8S4: Oi = those people (plural). Sevahi = chant. Saar = supreme. Gaakhree = hard. Bikham = difficult. Te nar = those people. Bhav utaar = carrying across the world-ocean. Nirbhaar = without burden, light, liberated.
Those who chant (his) supreme Shabad and do (this) hard and difficult work — the True Guru has carried them across the world-ocean and set them free.
Whoever accomplishes this most difficult task of contemplating the most sublime Word of the Shabad - those people cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and cast off their loads of sin.
They, who contemplate the sublime Name, which is a hard and difficult task, those persons cross the world ocean and are rid of their load of sins.
Those of your Sikhs who serve the (saar) supreme Shabad and do the very (bikham) hard work of devotion — you have freed those people from the burden of sins and carried them across the world-ocean.
VAD9: Sahaj saar = taking care of poise, keeping the state of poise. Sahaj = spiritual steadiness. Jaageele = wake up. Gur bichaar = through the reflection given by the True Guru. Nimmaree bhoot = become humble in nature. Piaar = in love.

(Those people) attain the state of poise in the company of the holy; through the blessing of the reflection given by the True Guru (their minds) wake up; they always stay (steeped) in humility and supreme love.
The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is celestial and sublime; whoever remains awake and aware, contemplating the Guru, embodies humility, and is imbued forever with the Supreme Love of the Lord.
O Guru Angad, true, divine and sublime is your association. You remain awake in the Guru's meditation, are the quintessence of humility and are ever imbued with the Lord's supreme love.

O True Guru! Your true sangat is naturally the very essence, for your intellect has awakened in reflection, and, always becoming humble — that is, holding humility — your love is for Parmeshvar, the (param) supreme power above all.
QXGM: O Kalsahar! Say: by touching the Guru of the world (Nanak Dev ji), the form of Muraari, the glory of (such a Guru Angad,) Lahna, is spreading through the whole world. ||2||
O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||2||
O Kalsahar, throughout the seven continents, recite you the praise of Lehna, who meeting with his Lord, became the Guru of the world.

Sri Kalsahar ji says: by (paras) meeting Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji, the form of Muraari, Sri Lahna ji has become Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, the Guru of the whole world within the seven continents. So, O mind, (kahu) speak — that is, utter — the glory of such a True Guru. ||2||
NWQZ: Tai tau = you indeed. Drirrio = have made firm, have enshrined in the heart. Apaar = boundless. Bimal = pure. Jaas = praise, glory. Bithaar = spread, expanse. Sujan = good people.
(O Guru Angad!) You have enshrined the boundless Name (of Akal Purakh) in your heart; your pure glory is spread abroad. You are the support of the lives of practitioners, siddhas and saints.
You hold tight to the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord; Your expanse is immaculate. You are the Support of the Siddhas and seekers, and the good and humble beings.
You resolutely remember the Name of the Infinite Lord, immaculate is whose extent and who is the support of the seekers, adepts, good people and all the beings.

O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji! You have made firm in your heart the Name of the boundless Vahiguru, whose (bimal) pure expanse is spread; and you are the support of all beings — those who rule, the siddhas, the (sujan) excellent people and the rest.
D2AP: Rahahi = you live. Jagatr = in the world. Jal padam beechaar = as the lotus (padam) lives in water (that is, stays detached). Jeea = life. Ko = of.

(O Guru Angad!) You are the incarnation of King Janak (in detachment) (that is, just as King Janak stayed detached, so you stay detached). Your Shabad is supreme in the world; you live in the world as detached as the lotus in water.
You are the incarnation of King Janak; the contemplation of Your Shabad is sublime throughout the universe. You abide in the world like the lotus on the water.
You are the incarnation of Janak, the King, sublime is the contemplation of your world in this universe. You live in this world like lotus in the water.

You are the incarnation of Sri Akal Purakh, the (janak) Father of all and King of all; and in this world your Shabad alone is the essence. And, through reflection, you live in the world as detached as the lotus leaf stays untouched in water.
A8WY: Kalipataru = the wish-fulfilling tree, the tree that grants desires (Sanskrit scholars hold that this tree is in Indra's heaven; see the Asa di Vaar steek, pauri 13, 'paarijaat'). Rog bidaar = remover of diseases. Sansaar taap nivaar = remover of the world's fevers. Aatma tribidh = beings of three kinds (that is, acting within the three gunas), worldly beings. Terai = in you (O Guru Angad!). Ek liv taar = keep up an unbroken absorption.
(O Guru Angad!) You are the wish-fulfilling tree, the remover of diseases, the one who ends the world's pains. All worldly beings sit with unbroken absorption in (your feet).
Like the Elyisan Tree, You cure all illnesses and take away the sufferings of the world. The three-phased soul is lovingly attuned to You alone.
Like the elysian tree you eradicate ailments and efface the sufferings of the world. The attention of my three-phased mind is fixed in your love alone.

Becoming the wish-fulfilling tree, you fulfil desires and (bidaar) destroy the disease of ignorance, and remove the world's fevers. The minds of beings are of the three gunas — sattva, rajas, tamas — and in your mind the absorption in the one Parmatma flows unbroken like a stream of oil. Or: the threefold self — Brahma, Vishnu and Shiv ji, the three forms — is in your view of one form alone; so in it your unbroken attention flows like a stream of oil.
EQD1: O Kalsahar! Say: by touching the Guru of the world (Nanak Dev ji), the form of Muraari, the glory of (such a Guru Angad,) Lahna, is spreading through the seven continents. ||3||
O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||3||
O Kalsahar, throughout the seven continents, recite you the praise of Lehna, who, meeting with his Lord, became the Guru of the world.

Sri Kalsahar ji says: by (paras) meeting Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji, the form of Muraari, Sri Lahna ji has become Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, the Guru of the whole world within the seven continents. So, O mind, (kahu) speak — that is, utter — the glory of such a True Guru. ||3||
4PLP: Hadrath = from the court, from the presence, from Guru Nanak. Parvaan = authoritative, acknowledged. Saadh = mastering, bringing under control. Ajgar = (the mind, like) a python. Jin = which (Guru Nanak). Unmaan = an exalted mind.
(O Guru Angad!) You have received honour from the presence (of Guru Nanak); you have served the acknowledged Guru (Nanak), who mastered the untameable mind and raised it high,
You were blessed with glory by the Prophet; You serve the Guru, certified by the Lord, who has subdued the snake of the mind, and who abides in the state of sublime bliss.
You were blessed with glory of Nanak, the Prophet and you served the Guru, approved by the Lord who disciplined his mind's snake, and abided in the state of sublime bliss.

O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji! You have received honour from the (hadrath) great one, Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji. For you have (parvaan) surely served Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji; through that, by (unmaan) reflection, you have (saadh) brought under control the (ajgar) huge serpent of ego.
ZCNF: Har har daras samaan = whose vision is like the vision of Hari. Aatma vant giaan = you have knowledge of the self. Jaaneea = you have known. Akal = (naasti kalaa avayavo yasya) the uniform, all-pervading Prabhu. Gat = the high spiritual state. Gur parvaan = of the acknowledged Guru (Nanak).

(O Guru Angad!) You have understood the high spiritual state of the acknowledged Guru (Nanak Dev ji), the form of the all-pervading Prabhu, whose vision is like the vision of Hari, who has knowledge of the self.
Your Vision is like that of the Lord, Your soul is a fount of spiritual wisdom; You know the unfathomable state of the certified Guru.
Your vision, O Guru Angad, is like the vision of the Lord God, your soul is all-knowing and you know the unfathomable state of the approved Guru.

So your vision is like that of the (har har) lords Brahma, Vishnu, Shiv and the rest. For your (aatma) mind is full of knowledge; so you have known the (gat) attainment of Parmeshvar, (akal) free of imaginings — that is, of stirrings — by accepting your Guru's command.
C4C4: Ja kee = whose (the acknowledged Guru Nanak's). Achal thaan = on the unmoving place; suthaan = on an excellent place. Pahir = wearing. Sanaah = a coat of mail and the like worn to protect the body in battle. Sakat = Maya. Bidaar = destroying.
(Guru Nanak,) whose gaze is (fixed) on the unmoving place, whose intellect is pure and set on the excellent place, and who, wearing the armour of a humble nature, destroyed (the influence of) Maya.
Your Gaze is focused upon the unmoving, unchanging place. Your Intellect is immaculate; it is focused upon the most sublime place. Wearing the armor of humility, you have overcome Maya.
Such is the Guru, whose eyes see the Master's immovable mansion, whose immaculate intellect is attached to the sublime site and who wearing the armour of humility has destroyed mammon.

O True Guru! Your gaze has reached the unmoving place, which is Brahm, and your intellect is pure; so, in the excellent place of the true sangat, you have put on the (sanaah) armour of (seel) calm and (bidaar) destroyed the strength of (sakat) Maya.
USXU: O Kalsahar! Say: by touching (the feet of) the Guru of the world (Nanak Dev ji), the form of Muraari, Lahna ji's glory is spreading through the whole world. ||4||
O Kal Sahaar, chant the Praises of Lehnaa throughout the seven continents; He met with the Lord, and became Guru of the World. ||4||
O Kalsahar, throughout the seven continents, recite you the praise of Lehna, who meeting with his Lord, became the Guru of the World.

Sri Kalsahar ji says: by (paras) meeting Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji, the form of Muraari, Sri Lahna ji has become Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, the Guru of the whole world within the seven continents. So, O mind, (kahu) speak — that is, utter — the glory of such a True Guru. ||4||
Z7WB: Drist dharat = as soon as he looks. Tam haran = remover of darkness. Dahan agh = burner of sins. Paap pranaasan = destroyer of sins.
(O Guru Angad!) As soon as you look, you remove the darkness (of ignorance); you are the burner of sins and the destroyer of sins.
Casting Your Glance of Grace, you dispel the darkness, burn away evil, and destroy sin.
Casting your glance, you dispel darkness, burn sins and destroy wickedness.

O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji! On whomever you cast your glance of grace, you take away their (tam) darkness of ignorance, burn their heavy (agh) sins, and quite naturally (pra) wholly destroy their ordinary sins as well.
L3GJ: Sabad soor = hero of the Shabad.
You are a hero of the Shabad and mighty; you destroy lust and anger.
You are the Heroic Warrior of the Shabad, the Word of God. Your Power destroys sexual desire and anger.
You are the Lord's hero, who are powerful to destroy lust and wrath.
Holding the unfailing weapon of the Shabad, you are a mighty hero; for by that teaching you destroy lust and anger from the hearts of your servants.
SV6L: (O Guru Angad!) You have brought greed and attachment under control; you sustain the beggars who come to your refuge,
You have overpowered greed and emotional attachment; You nurture and cherish those who seek Your Sanctuary.
You have overcome avarice and worldly love and you cherish the seekers of your refuge.
You bring greed, attachment and the rest under control, and you sustain the (jaachik) beggars — that is, the seekers who beg for liberation — who come to your refuge.
J7DL: Aatam rat = spiritual love. Kahan = sayings, words. Kal = beautiful. Dhaalan = flow.
You have gathered spiritual love; your words are beautiful springs of amrit.
You gather in the joyful love of the soul; Your Words have the Potency to bring forth Ambrosial Nectar.
You amass spiritual love and your spiritual-word is the machine to cast Nectar.
You have (san) thoroughly taken up (rat) love for your own true self; and your (dhaalan) manner of (kahan) speaking is amrit-like and (kal) beautiful.
3KU0: Kal = O Kalsahar! Sat = with certainty, with faith.
O Kalsahar! The True Guru (Angad Dev) is the crowning Guru. The person who falls at his feet with faith crosses over.
You are appointed the True Guru, the True Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; whoever is truly attached to You is carried across.
You are the anointed True Guru, yea, the True Guru of the Darkage. Whosoever attaches to you, O True, Guru, he is saved.
O True Guru Angad Sahib ji! The True Guru Nanak Sahib ji gave you the (kal) beautiful tilak of Guruship; so those who (sat) surely fall at your feet (pai) again and again are carried across.
7NLE: Gur jagat = the Guru of the world. Phiran seeh = the noble son of Baba Pheru. Angarau = Guru Angad Dev. ||5||
The Guru of the world, Lahna ji, the noble son of Baba Pheru (ji), (Guru) Angad, enjoys rule and yoga. ||5||
The lion, the son of Pheru, is Guru Angad, the Guru of the World; Lehnaa practices Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||5||
Lehna the tiger like son of Pheru, is the Guru of the world and enjoys temporal and spiritual powers.
O Guru of the world, Lahna ji, (seeh) son of (phiran) Pheru ji! You yourself, having become Sri Guru (angarau) Angad Sahib, practise the (raaj) yoga of knowledge. ||5||

HHJ4: Akal = without parts (kala), the uniform, all-pervading Prabhu. Liv = attention. Karan siu = in deeds. Ichha chaarah = free.
(O Guru Angad!) Your attention stays ever settled in Akal Purakh; in deeds you are free (that is, Maya and the like have no hold on you).
Your mind remains lovingly attuned to the Lord forever; You do whatever you desire.
Your intellect ever abides in the Lord's love and you yoke (graze) yours organs according to your will.
Your (liv) attention always stays (akal) free of imaginings, and you (bichaarate) govern the (karan) senses by your own will; meaning, you have subdued your senses.
47KR: Drum = tree. Sapoor = laden (with fruit). Khavai = bears. Kas = trouble. Bimal = pure.
Just as a fruit-laden tree bows down and bears trouble, so is the pure thought (of Guru Angad) (that is, Guru Angad too bows down in the same way, and bears trouble for the sake of worldly beings).
Like the tree heavy with fruit, You bow in humility, and endure the pain of it; You are pure of thought.
Immaculate are yours thoughts and you bend low in humility like the fruit-laden tree and you endure the sufferings of being fruitful.

Just as a tree full of fruit bows down, so you, though all-powerful, are full of humility; for, (khavai) bearing the (kas) touchstone of Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji's testing, you have become one of pure reflection.
ZMT7: Tat = secret. Sarab gat = all-pervading. Alakh = the One whose secret cannot be found. Bidaanee = wondrous.
(O Guru Angad!) You have found this secret: that the wondrous and unseeable Hari pervades all.
You realize this reality, that the Lord is All-pervading, Unseen and Amazing.
You realise this reality, that unseen and wondrous is the Omnipresent Lord.
The unseeable and (bidaanee) wondrous Consciousness that (gat) is present in all — (ihai) this you have known as the (tat) essence.
VCVW: Sahaj bhaai = naturally, spontaneously. Kiran = through the ray. Kal = beautiful.
Through the ray of the beautiful Bani full of amrit, you naturally sprinkle amrit (into the hearts of worldly beings).
With intuitive ease, You send forth the rays of the Ambrosial Word of power.
With the ambrosial and beauteous rays of the Guru's word, you have all-too-spontaneously irrigated the mortals.

Through the rays of the Bani of the moon that is Sri Guru Nanak Dev, you have gathered in your heart the beautiful amrit of peace. Or: into the hearts of those who have come to the refuge of you, the moon, you have sprinkled the (kal) beautiful amrit of the Name through the rays of your naturally flowing Bani.
44RU: Gur gam pramaan = the rank of Guru Nanak. Gam = gamya, that which can be reached. Gur gam = where the Guru (Nanak) reaches. Pramaan = rank. Graahaj layau = has taken up.
(O Guru Angad!) You have attained the rank of the Guru (Nanak Dev ji), and have taken up truth and contentment.
You have risen to the state of the certified Guru; you grasp truth and contentment.
You have obtained the status of the accepted Guru and has grasped truth and contentment.
Through the True Guru's granting of access — that is, through knowledge — you have gained (pramaan) certainty; so you have (graahaj) taken up truth, contentment and other virtues.
PPCD: Samulvai = proclaims aloud. Darsan Lahne = the vision of Lahna ji. Bhayau = happened. ||6||
Kalsahar (the poet) proclaims aloud: "Those people who have had the vision of Lahna ji have touched Akal Purakh." ||6||
KAL proclaims, that whoever attains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of Lehnaa, meets with the Lord. ||6||
Proclaims Kalsahar, whosoever attains the vision of Lehna, he meets with his God.

Sri 'Kal' ji says: O True Guru! I (san) thoroughly (mulvai) utter your praise. Those people who have had your vision, O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji in the form of Sri Lahna — they have (parsio) met Hari. ||6||
6GMJ: Man = in the mind. Bisaas = faith. Gahar = in the deep (Hari). Gahu = access. Hadrath = by the Hazrat, by Guru Nanak.
(O Guru Angad!) You have gained faith in your mind; the Master (Guru Nanak ji) has given you access to the deep (Hari).
My mind has faith, that the Prophet has given You access to the Profound Lord.
In my mind is the belief that Nanak, the prophet, has blessed you with the access to the profound Lord.

O True Guru! You have gained (bisaas) certainty in the mind, for the (hadrath) great True Guru Nanak Dev ji has made you (gahu) grasp — that is, attain — Vahiguru, the (gahar) deep, unfathomable form.
1PG0: Garal = poison. Tan = out of the body. Amio = amrit, the water of the Name that gives spiritual life. Antar gat = within the soul, within oneself. Peeo = has drunk.
The destroying poison (that is, attachment to Maya) has fled from your body, and you have drunk the Name-amrit within your soul.
Your body has been purged of the deadly poison; You drink the Ambrosial Nectar deep within.
The fatal poison of sins has hastened away from the body and from within you, you in-drink the name Nectar.
So the poison of sense-desire, which destroys beings, has run out of your body — that is, gone. For you have drunk the amrit of the bliss of the self, which is (gat) attained within the heart.
NADA: Alakh = by Akal Purakh. Kal = power. Jugantar = in the ages. Rid = in the heart. Bigaas = light.
The light of Akal Purakh, who has placed His power in (all) the ages, has awakened in (Guru Angad's) heart.
Your Heart has blossomed forth in awareness of the Unseen Lord, who has infused His Power throughout the ages.
The unseen Lord, who has placed His power throughout all the ages, His Light has become manifest within his mind.
The light of knowledge of that unseeable Vahiguru who has placed His (kal) power within all the ages has awakened — that is, become manifest — in your heart.
8YY2: Ravio = pervades. Saamaan = equally. Nirantar = within all, uniformly, without gap. Sahaj = (of) spiritual steadiness.
Akal Purakh pervades within all uniformly; in Him the True Guru (Angad Dev) keeps up a samadhi of spiritual steadiness.
O True Guru, You are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi, with continuity and equality.
You, O True Guru, are merged in the trance of equipoise of Him, who is equally contained among all.
In that Akal Purakh who (ravio) pervades all equally and without break, O True Guru ji, your samadhi is naturally fixed.
A6VY: Udaarau chit = large-hearted. Daarid haran = remover of poverty. Pikhantih = at the very sight. Kalmal = sins. Trasan = to be afraid.
The one who is large-hearted, who removes poverty, and at the sight of whom sins tremble —
You are open-minded and large-hearted, the Destroyer of poverty; seeing You, sins are afraid.
You are open-hearted and the destroyer of poverty, seeing whom the sins are terrified.
By (pikhantih) seeing the vision of the large-hearted True Guru, remover of poverty, the hosts of (kalmal) sins come to (trasan) fear — that is, are destroyed.
EVGE: Sad = always. Rang = in colour, with love. Sahaj = (settled) in spiritual steadiness. Uchrai = says. Jas = glory. Jampau = I utter. Rasan = with the tongue. ||7||
Kalsahar says: "I always utter with my tongue the praise of that Lahna ji, in love and (settled) in spiritual steadiness." ||7||
Says KAL, I lovingly, continually, intuitively chant the Praises of Lehnaa with my tongue. ||7||
Says Kalsahar, with my tongue, I al-too-spontaneously ever lovingly recite the praise of Lehna.
Sri 'Kal' ji says: O brother! I utter with the tongue the praise of Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, (sad rang) always with love. ||7||
DEC1: Avkhadh = medicine, herb. Samaadh sukh = the bliss gained in samadhi. Naam neesaan = the banner of the Name. Sohai = shines.
Akal Purakh's Name is the medicine (for all diseases), the Name is the support (of all), and the Name itself is the bliss of samadhi; the banner of Akal Purakh's Name shines for ever.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our medicine; the Naam is our support; the Naam is the peace of Samaadhi. The Naam is the insignia which embellishes us forever.
The Name is your medicine, the Name your mainstay, the Name your peace of trance and the stamp of the Lord's Name ever embellishes you.

You have made the Name alone the medicine, and the Name alone your (aadhaar) support; chanting the Name is your bliss of samadhi; and the (neesaan) banner — or the warrant — of the Name alone shines in your hand.
HNS2: Rang ratau = dyed in colour. Naam siu = through the blessing of the Name. Sur = gods. Narah = humans. Bohai = makes fragrant. Kal = O Kalsahar!
O Kalsahar! Through the blessing of Hari's Name (Guru Angad) is dyed in its colour. This Name makes gods and humans fragrant.
KAL is imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Naam which is the fragrance of gods and human beings.
You are imbued with love of the Lord's Name and the beauteous Name perfumes the God's and men.
You are dyed in the colour of that Vahiguru's Name, the (kal) beautiful Name that has made (sur) gods, (nar) humans and all others (bohai) fragrant with glory.
RNKN: Paras = touch. Jin = who. Sat rav = the sun of truth in all its forms. Loi = in creation.
The person who has gained the touch of the Name (from Guru Angad Dev ji) — their sun of truth and dharma has blazed forth in the world.
Whoever obtains the Naam, the Philosopher's Stone, becomes the embodiment of Truth, manifest and radiant throughout the world.
Whosoever finds the philosopher's stone of the Name, he becomes the embodiment of truth and the sun of his glory shines in the world.

O True Guru! Those who have gained from you the (paras) meeting — or the axe — of the Name, through them your (sat) glory has shone out like the sun through the worlds, up to the realm of the sun; or, like the light of the sun, it is manifest in all.
609A: Darsan parsiai = by having the vision. Athsath = the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage. Majan = bathing. Sat = high conduct. ||8||
By having the vision of the True Guru (Angad Dev ji), the bathing at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage is done. ||8||
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it is as if one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||8||
Seeing the Guru's vision, one attains to the merit of the ablution at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji! By beholding — that is, having — your vision, the fruit of bathing at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage is gained. ||8||
B8A3: Sach = the Name of the True Hari. Bhaakhant = while uttering. Sohai = shines.

The Name of the ever-abiding Hari alone is (Guru Angad Dev ji's) pilgrimage, the Name alone is his bathing, and love for the Name is (his) food. (Guru Angad) shines as he utters the Name of the ever-abiding Prabhu.
The True Name is the sacred shrine, the True Name is the cleansing bath of purification and food. The True Name is eternal love; chant the True Name, and be embellished.
O Guru, the True Name is your pilgrim-station, the True Name is your ablution and diet, the True Name you love and, ever reciting the True Name, you are embellished.

O True Guru! In your heart the true Name alone is the pilgrimage; chanting the true Name alone is your bathing; the food of the true Name alone (bhaau) pleases you; and the uttering of the true Name always shines in your mouth.
E4X3: Gur sabad = through the Guru's Shabad. Sangat = the sangats. Bohai = makes fragrant.
(Guru Angad Dev ji) gained Akal Purakh's Name through the Shabad of the Guru (Nanak Dev ji); this true Name makes the sangats fragrant.
The True Name is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, is fragrant with the True Name.
By the Guru's instruction, you have obtained the True Name and the True Name makes fragrant the saints' society.
From Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji you gained the (sabad) teaching of the true Name alone; and with that Name you have made all your sangat (bohai) fragrant.
JQD3: Jis sanjam = whose (Guru Angad Dev ji's) discipline. Kal = O Kalsahar! Vakhaan = say.
The servant, the poet Kalsahar, says: (Guru Angad Dev ji,) whose discipline is Akal Purakh's Name and whose fast too is Hari's Name —
KAL the poet utters the Praises of the one whose self-discipline is the True Name, and whose fast is the True Name.
The poetical person, Kalsahar narrates the praise of him, the True Name is whose self-discipline and the True Name, the fasting.
O True Guru ji! Your discipline is the Name alone, and your fast is the true Name alone. Sri 'Kal' ji says: the poets utter your praise like this:
AVF7: Sach = the ever-abiding Name of Hari. Parvaan = approved, accepted, fruitful. ||9||
by having the vision of that Guru, the ever-abiding Name of Hari is gained and human birth becomes fruitful. ||9||
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, one's life is approved and certified in the True Name. ||9||
Seeing the Guru's sight, the human life is truly approved.
O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji! By beholding your vision, (sach) surely this birth becomes (parvaan) fruitful. ||9||
B21H: Amia = amrit-filled, giving spiritual life. Drist = glance. Harai = removes. Agh = sins. Sakal mal = all the filth.
(Guru Angad Dev,) on whomever he casts his good glance that gives spiritual life, removes (their) sins and all their filth,
When You bestow Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace, You eradicate all wickedness, sin and filth.
You banish all the sins, wickedness and filth of him, on whom you caste your sublime and ambrosial glance.
O True Guru ji! On whomever you cast your amrit-like auspicious glance, you take away all their ordinary sins and great (agh) sins.
4YHP: Vas karai = brings under control. Bal = ego.
and brings lust, anger, greed, attachment and ego — all of these — under his control.
Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - You have overcome all these powerful passions.
Lust, wrath, avarice and worldly love; all these mighty passions, you have overpowered.
And you bring under their control all the mighty vices — lust and anger, greed, attachment and the rest.
A939: Man = in the mind. Sansaarah = of the world. Khovai = destroys.
Comfort always dwells in (Guru Angad's) mind; (he) removes the pain of the world.
Your mind is filled with peace forever; You banish the sufferings of the world.
Peace ever abides within your mind and you banish the pain of the world.
In that person's mind comforts always dwell, and they (khovai) do away with all the world's pains of birth and death; meaning, they get rid of them.
1EAD: Navnidh dareeaau = the river of the nine treasures. Janam ham = of our births. Nidh = treasure.
The True Guru is a river of the nine treasures; he washes away the blackness of our births.
The Guru is the river of the nine treasures, washing off the dirt of our lives.
The Guru is the river of the nine treasures and washes off the soot of the sins of our lives.
So, O Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji! You are the nine treasures and a river in form, for you wash away the blackness of the sins of (ham) all our births; meaning, you free us from birth and death.
XB8C: Tal = O Tal! O Kalh! O Kalsahar! Ah = day. Nis = night. Sahaj = in spiritual steadiness. Subhaai = in love.
O Kalsahar! [?] One should serve (such a) Guru (Angad Dev ji) day and night, settled in spiritual steadiness and love.
So speaks TAL the poet: serve the Guru, day and night, with intuitive love and affection.
Says Tall, therefore, day and night, spontaneously serve you, your Guru.
'Tal' ji says: O brother! Serve such a True Guru naturally and without break.
167G: By having the vision of (such) a True Guru, the pain of birth and death is cut away. ||10||
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru, the pains of death and rebirth are taken away. ||10||
On beholding the vision of the Guru, the pain of birth and death departs.
O brother! By having the True Guru's vision, the pain of birth and death goes away. ||10||
6650: Savaiye uttered in praise of Guru Amardas ji.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Third Mehl:
Sawayas in praise of the 3rd Guru.
The Bhatts, who are the Vedas in form, utter the praise of Sri Guru Amardas Sahib, the Third Patshah:
1QQQ: Akal Purakh is One, and is found through the True Guru's grace.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By the True Guru's grace, is He attained to.
CS73: Sivar = remember. Saacha = ever-abiding. Ja ka = whose (Hari's). Achhal = who cannot be deceived. Sansaare = in the world.
Remember that ever-abiding Akal Purakh, whose one Name is undeceivable in the world.
Dwell upon that Primal Being, the True Lord God; in this world, His One Name is Undeceivable.
Meditate you on the True Lord, whose One Name is Undeceivable in this world.
Remember that true (purakh) Being, Vahiguru, whose one Name is of undeceivable form in the world.
2Z6P: Remember that excellent Name which has carried the devotees across the world-ocean.
He carries His devotees across the terrifying world-ocean; meditate in remembrance on His Naam, Supreme and Sublime.
Contemplate you the most sublime Name of Him alone, who has ferried His devotees across the dreadful world ocean.
The Name by which the devotees were carried across the world-ocean — the chanting of the Name, which is (pardhaan) the chief of all practices — that very Name I remember in my heart.
D9T3: Tit naam = in that very Name. Rasik = one who enjoys. Thapio = was installed, was set. Jen = because of which (that is, through the blessing of that very Name). Srab sidhee = all the powers (were gained).
(Guru) Nanak enjoys the bliss of that very Name; (through that same Name) Lahna ji was installed, by which all the powers came to him.
Nanak delighted in the Naam; He established Lehnaa as Guru, who was imbued with all supernatural spiritual powers.
Guru Nanak, the cherisher of that Name, established Lehna as the Guru, who was blessed with all the supernatural powers.
Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, the lover of that Name — that Guru ji installed Lahna ji on the seat of Guruship; by which all powers came to Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji.
5HRY: Sabudhee = of intellect, of high understanding. Keerat = glory. Jan = among people. Amardaas = of Guru Amardas. Bistreeya = is spread.
O poet Kalh! (Through its blessing) the glory of Guru Amardas, of high understanding, is spreading among the people.
So speaks KALL the poet: the glory of the wise, sublime and humble Amar Daas is spread throughout the world.
Says Kal, the poetical person, that the glory of the supremely wise saint Amar Dass in spread throughout the world.
The poet Sri Kal ji says: the glory of Guru Amardas ji, the servant of that Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, of (sabudhee) excellent intellect, is spreading through the world. ☬ How has that glory spread?
Z0X0: Keerat rav kiran = through the ray of the sun of glory. Rav = sun. Keerat = glory. Pragat = becoming manifest, spreading. Sansaarah = in the world. Saakh = branches. Tarovar = excellent tree. Mavalsara = the maulsari tree; its small flowers have a very sweet and delicate fragrance.
(Just as) the branches of the excellent maulsari tree (spread and scatter fragrance, so,) because the ray of the sun of (Guru Amardas's) glory has become manifest in the world —
His Praises radiate throughout the world, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the maulsar (fragrant) tree.
Your praise is manifest in the world, like the rays of the sun and the fragrance of the boughs of the tree of mimusopselengi.

That glory is manifest in the whole world like the rays of the (rav) sun; that is, it is shining. In the (saakh) fields and the (tarovar) trees — that is, in the inert and the moving, (sara) in all, or (sara) in the oceans — it is (maval) mingling.
JPS2: Utar = north, towards the mountains. Dakhinah = towards the south. Pub = to the east. Paschm = towards the west. Japanth = chant.
North, south, east and west (that is, on every side) people are hailing the victory of Guru Amardas ji.
In the north, south, east and west, people proclaim Your Victory.
In the north, south, east and west, men shout forth the slogans of your victory.
In all four directions — east, north, south, west — all people, crying victory, chant the name of the True Guru Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji.

P93H: Rasan = with the tongue (that is, by uttering). Gurmukh = by the Guru (Nanak). Bardaayau = distributed. Ulat = turning back. Gang = the flow of the Ganga, the attention of beings. Paschm = to the west, turned away from Maya. Dhareea = settled.
The Name of Hari which Guru Nanak Dev ji uttered and distributed, and (by which he) turned the attention [sic: printed 'thriti', for 'briti'] of worldly beings back from the world —
The Guru spoke the Lord's Name with His mouth and broadcast it throughout the world, to turn the tide of the hearts of men.
God's Name, which the supreme Guru, by his tongue, had distributed among men to turn the tide of their mind (Ganges) towards the West;

Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, O Guru Amardas ji, gave you from his mouth the boon of Hari's Name with the tongue. Or: O Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, you have distributed Hari's Name with your tongue through your mouth — that is, taught it. And the Ganga, which flows to the east, you have turned back and set in the west. The meaning is: sons are the heirs of a father's wealth, but the True Guru, though there were sons, passed them over and gave the Guruship to his own Sikhs; or, he turned the outward-going attention inward.
PBUU: Bhagtah bhav taaran = carrying the devotees across the world. Phuria = was realised. ||1||
that same undeceivable Name, the Name that carries devotees across the world, became manifest in Guru Amardas ji's heart. ||1||
That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||1||
the same Undeceivable Name, that ferries the saints across the world-ocean, came into the mind of Guru Amar Dass.
The Name that is of undeceivable form, that carries the devotees across the world-ocean — that very Name (phuria) came to Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji; meaning, was attained by him. ||1||
03C5: That very Name is remembered by the Yakshas, the Kinnars, the practitioners, the siddhas and Shiv ji in samadhi.
The gods and heavenly heralds, the Siddhas and seekers and Shiva in Samaadhi meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The sublime gods, heavenly singers, the strivers, adepts and Shiva in his trance, all contemplate on the same Name.
(Soee) that very Name is remembered by the gods such as the Yakshas and Kinnars, by those who do practices, by the siddhas, and by Shiv ji and others who (hara) sit in samadhi.
FC51: Nakhyatr = stars. Dhroo mandal = the stars of the devotee Dhru. Vara = excellent.
That same Name is chanted by countless stars, by the realms of the devotee Dhru, and by excellent devotees such as Narad and Prahlad.
The stars and the realms of Dhroo, and devotees like Naaraad and Prahlaad meditate on the Naam.
The stars, Dhru in his realm, the sages like Narad, Prahlad and good people, meditate on the same Name.
The (nakhyatr) stars, Dhru in his own (mandal) realm, rishis such as Narad, devotees such as Prahlad, and all such (vara) excellent people — all of them remember that very Name.
10G1: Saseear = the moon (shashadhar). Ar = and. Soor = the sun. Ulaasahi = long for, yearn for. Sail loa = heaps of stones. Sail = stone, mountain. Loa = world, heap. Udhaaria = carried across. Jin = which (Name).
The moon and the sun long for that same Name of Hari, which carried heaps of stones across.
The moon and the sun long for the Naam; it has saved even mountain ranges.
The moon and the sun long for the Name, which has emancipated the ranges after ranges of mountains.

(Saseear) the moon and the sun too (ulaasahi) utter the Name — the Name which saved the people who were inert like (sail) mountains, or heavy with the (sail) stones of sins; or which saved mountains and worlds.
STGR: That same undeceivable Name, the Name that carries devotees across the world, became manifest in the heart of the True Guru Amardas ji. ||2||
That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||2||
Yea, the very same Undeceivable Name, that ferries the saints across the world ocean, came into the mind of Guru Amar Dass.
The Name that is of undeceivable form, that carries the devotees across the world-ocean — that very Name (phuria) came to Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji; meaning, was attained by him. ||2||
KPF7: Sivar = remembering. Nav = nine. Niranjan = the stainless Hari (nir-anjan, free of the soot of Maya). Samudharia = crossed over, went across.
The nine Naths, Shiv ji, Sanak and the rest crossed over by remembering that same pure Name;
Dwelling upon that Immaculate Naam, the nine Yogic masters, Shiva and Sanak and many others have been emancipated.
Contemplating the same immaculate Name, the nine great Yogis, Shiva and Sanak etc. have been wholly emancipated.

The nine Naths remember that very Name of Vahiguru, (niranjan) free of Maya, and Shiv ji and Sanak and the rest have (san) thoroughly held that Name in their hearts; or, the Name which has thoroughly saved Shiv, Sanak and the rest.
6HK0: Jit = in which (Name). Budh = wise people, people of knowledge. Raate = dyed, coloured.
The eighty-four siddhas and other people of knowledge are dyed in that same colour; (through the blessing of that same Name) Ambreek crossed the world-ocean.
The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.
The eighty-four men of miracles and Budhas are imbued with the Name, by which Ambrik was ferried across the dreadful world ocean.

The Name in which the eighty-four siddhas and Budh and the other nine planets — or the wise — have all become (raate) full of love; and by chanting that Name the devotee Ambreek crossed the world-ocean.
6MPP: Kal = in the Kali age. Kilvikh = sins. Haria = removed. Udhau = a devotee of Krishan ji. Akroor = a devotee of Krishan ji.
That same Name was remembered by Udhav, Akroor, Trilochan and the devotee Namdev; (that same Name) removed Kabir's sins in the Kali age.
It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
The Name effaced the sins of Oodho, Akrur and, in the Darkage, of Tirlochan, Nam Dev and Kabir.
Udhav ji, Akroor, Trilochan, the devotee Namdev ji, and in the Kali age all the devotees beginning with Kabir ji — by chanting that Name they (haria) removed all (kilvikh) sins.
8Z8G: That same undeceivable Name, the Name that carries devotees across the world, was realised by the True Guru Amardas ji. ||3||
That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||
The very same Undeceivable Name, which ferries the saints across the world ocean, came into the mind of Guru Amar Dass.
The Name that is of undeceivable form, that carries the devotees across the world-ocean — that very Name (phuria) came to Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji; meaning, was attained by him. ||3||
U9M1: Tit naam = in that very Name. Laag = joined, attached. Tetees = the thirty-three crore gods. Tapeesur man = in the minds of the great ascetics.
The thirty-three crore gods, joined to that Name, are remembering (Akal Purakh); (that same Name) dwells in the minds of the celibates and the great ascetics.
The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.
To that very Name are attached thirty-three millions of angles who remember it ever and it is also enshrined within the mind of the celibates and penitents.
Attached to that very Name, the thirty-three crore gods too meditate on Vahiguru; and that same Name has settled in the minds of the celibates and the lords of ascetics.
T4GN: Gangev pitaamah = Bhishm Pitamah, son of the Ganga. Charan = in (Hari's) feet (by being joined). Rasia = made to trickle.
By remembering that same Name and being joined to Akal Purakh's feet, the Name-amrit trickled into Bhishm Pitamah's mind.
Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.
Meditating on that very Name, the Ganga's son, Bhisham Pitama, enjoyed in his mind the ambrosia of the Lord's feet.

Remembering that very Name, the mind of Bhishm Pitamah, (gangev) the son of the Ganga, became (rasia) steeped in the amrit of the bliss of meditating on Parmeshvar's feet; meaning, it became one with it.
WM9Q: Garooa mat = of deep wisdom, of high wisdom. Guroo = through the Guru. Sat kar = with faith, with devotion. Udhareea = is crossing over.
Joined to that same Name, through the deep and high-minded True Guru, by the grace of complete faith, the sangat is crossing over.
The great and profound Guru has brought forth the Naam; accepting the teachings as true, the Holy Congregation has been saved.
Contemplating the self-same Name and accepting as true the instruction of the profound Great Guru, the saints have been emancipated.
The deep Guru, giving (garooa mat) weighty teaching of that Name, has (sat) surely saved the sangat.
GHV4: That same undeceivable Name, the Name that carries devotees across the world-ocean, became manifest in Guru Amardas's heart. ||4||
That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||4||
The very same Undeceivable Name, which ferries the saints across the world ocean, came into the mind of Guru Amar Dass.
The Name that is of undeceivable form, that carries the devotees across the world-ocean — that very Name (phuria) came to Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji; meaning, was attained by him. ||4||
YN9A: Kit = keerat, glory, greatness. Naam kit = the greatness of the Name. Sansaar = in the world. Rav = sun. Kiran = through the ray. Surtar = the tree of heaven (sur = heaven; tar = tree). Saakhah = branches.
(Just as) the branches of the tree of heaven (the maulsari) (spread and scatter fragrance, so) because the ray of the sun of the greatness of Parmatma's Name (shines) in the world —
The Glory of the Naam shines forth, like the rays of the sun, and the branches of the Elysian Tree.
The Name's glory's is spread in the world like the sun's rays and the fragrance of the boughs of the elysian tree.
The (kit) glory of the Name of Vahiguru shines in the world like the rays of the sun, and, like the (saakhah) branches of the (surtar) wish-fulfilling tree, fulfils the desires of the mind.
G786: Jas = praise. Bhaakhah = utter. Utar = in the north (country). Pub = in the east (country). Paschm = in the west (country).
in the north, south, east and west (that is, on every side), people are uttering the praise of the Name.
In the countries of the north, south, east and west, the Praises of the Naam are chanted.
And its praise is recited in the countries of the north, south, east and the west.
From the north, south and east to the western direction too, people utter the praise of the Name alone.
C0HJ: Ta = then. Sakayath = fruitful, successful. Jit = in which (birth). Ridai = in the heart. Nivaasai = dwells.
That birth alone is fruitful in which Parmatma's Name dwells in the heart.
Life is fruitful, when the Name of the Lord abides in the heart.
That life alone is fruitful, in whose heart abides the Lord's Name.
This birth is fruitful indeed in which Hari's Name dwells in the heart.
7J5K: Chhia darsan = the six garbs, yogis, Jangams and the rest. Aasaasai = long for (aasaasahi). Sur = gods. Nar = humans. Gandharab = the musicians of the gods.
Gods, humans, the ganas, the Gandharbas and all six garbs long for this Name.
The angelic beings, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shaastras yearn for the Naam.
For the Lord's Name, crave the angelic persons, heavenly heralds, celestial singers and the six Shashtras.

(Sur) gods and humans, ganas and Gandharbas and others, and the six schools that are garbs — all of them (aasaasai) want only the Name in their hearts; or, by chanting the Name they become (asans) free of doubt; or, they become (aasaasai) free of Yama's rebuke.
Y6ET: Bhalau prasidh = renowned in the Bhalla clan. Tejo tanau = the son of Tej Bhan ji. Jorr kar = joining the hands.
Kalh the poet worships with joined hands (Guru Amardas ji), the son of Tej Bhan ji, renowned in the Bhalla clan, (and says):
The son of Tayj Bhaan of the Bhalla dynasty is noble and famous; with his palms pressed together, KALL meditates on Him.
Illustrious is Amar Dass, the son of Tej Bhan of Bhalla dynasty. Him contemplates Kall with joined hands.
O Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, (tanau) son of Sri Tejo ji, in the renowned (bhalau) excellent clan! Sri Kal ji says: I have meditated on your lotus feet with joined hands.
R7GT: Bhagat bhavjal haran = the remover of the devotees' birth and death. Gur Amardaas = O Guru Amardas! Tai = you. ||5||
"O Guru Amardas! You have gained that same Name which cuts away the birth and death of devotees." ||5||
The Naam takes away the fears of the devotees about the word-ocean; Guru Amar Daas has obtained it. ||5||
O Guru Amar Dass, you are blessed with the same Name, which removes the fear of the devotees about world-ocean.
The Name that takes away the devotees' world-ocean — O Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, you have gained that very Name. ||5||
QSKH: Tetees = thirty-three crore. Naam = the Name has. Dhaare = established.
Parmatma's Name is meditated on by the thirty-three crore gods, by practitioners, siddhas and humans. Hari's Name alone has established all the continents and universes (that is, all the worlds).
The thirty-one million gods meditate on the Naam, along with the Siddhas and seekers; the Naam supports solar systems and galaxies.
The thirty-one millions of gods strivers, adepts and men remember the name and the Name upholds the worlds and universes.
The Name on which the thirty-three crore gods, and the practitioners, siddhas and humans meditate — and Parmeshvar, the Named One, has upheld the universes with their continents.
FLAK: Jah = those who. Samaadhio = have chanted. Harakh sog = joy and sorrow, bliss and worry. Sam kar = treating as the same, as equal. Sahaare = have borne.
Those who have remembered Hari's Name have borne joy and worry alike.
One who meditates on the Naam in Samaadhi, endures sorrow and joy as one and the same.
He, who contemplates the Lord's Name; he bears weal and woe alike.
The person who has (san) thoroughly worshipped that Name has borne joy and sorrow and the like as equal.
B6KY: Siromani = supreme, excellent. Sarab mai = pervading all. Liv dhaar = fixing absorption, joining attention. Rahe = stay settled.
(Of all treasures) the treasure of the Name of all-pervading Hari is supreme; the devotees stay settled in this Name, joining their attention to it.
The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.

In that lineage (appeared) Guru Amardas, the fulfiller of hopes. Which of his virtues can I tell?
Guru Amar Daas of that dynasty is the home of hope. How can I express His Glorious Virtues?
Guru Amar Dass, the abode of hope, became manifest in that dynasty, How can I narrate his praise?

In the lineage — the order — of that Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji has become the (nivaas) vessel of hopes; meaning, the fulfiller of the hopes of all Sikhs; or, free of hope. So which of his virtues can I utter? The meaning is that his virtues are endless.
SZCG: Tinah gun ant = the end of those virtues. Na jaanau = I do not know. Alakh = beyond description. Agamm = unreachable.
Those virtues are indescribable and unreachable; I do not know the end of those virtues.
His Virtues are unknowable and unfathomable. I do not know the limits of His Virtues.
Fathomless and infinite are the virtues that he possesses. Of those virtues, I know not the limit.
The virtues that are in the unseeable, unreachable Vahiguru are in him; so I do not know the end of those virtues.
5FQJ: Bohithau = ship. Bidhaatai = by the Creator. Nirmayau = has made. Udharan = to save, to carry across.

The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, has made Him a boat to carry all His generations across, along with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.
The Creator-Lord has made him a boat to ferry across his whole following and lineage.
(Bidhaatai) Sri Akal Purakh ji has (nirmayau) brought the True Guru into being as a (bohithau) ship to save the whole sangat and their lineages.

MSXA: Kala dhaar = establishing his power. Jag mah = in the world. Parvariyau = has come forth into activity.
(Guru Amardas) himself is the form of Narayan, who, establishing his power, has come forth into the world.

Assuming power, the Primal Being, of Himself, has entered into the world in the form of the True Guru.
Narayan, the holder of all (kala) powers, has himself, taking the form of the True Guru, (parvariyau) come forth into the world; meaning, he himself has taken incarnation.
6Q40: Nirankaar = by the Formless One. Aakaar = taking form. Jag mandal = in the sphere of the world. Jot kariyau = has made the light manifest.

The Formless Lord took form, and with His Light He illuminated the realms of the world.
Assuming the form of Guru Amar Dass, the Formless Lord has shed light in the world realm.
That Formless One, taking form as the True Guru, has lit up the sphere of the world with his own light.
S5PR: Jah kah = wherever. Tah = there. Bharpoor = pervading, ever-present. Sabad = the Shabad. Deepak = with the lamp (that is, through the lamp that is Guru Amardas). Deepaayau = lit, made to shine, made manifest.
(The Formless One) has made manifest, through the lamp (that is Guru Amardas), his Shabad (the Name), which is present everywhere.
He is All-pervading everywhere; the Lamp of the Shabad, the Word, has been lit.
The Lord is fully pervading every-where. It is the Guru, who has lighted the lamp of His Name.

The Brahm who pervades everywhere in the three worlds — that Parbrahm the True Guru has lit up in the hearts of beings with the lamp of (sabad) teaching; meaning, he has given the knowledge of that Parbrahm in the Sikhs' hearts.
JCTA: Jih sikhah = the Sikhs who. Tat = at once, immediately.
The Sikhs who have taken up this Shabad, (Guru Amardas ji) has at once joined (them) to Hari's feet.
Whoever gathers in the essence of the teachings shall be absorbed in the Feet of the Lord.
Whosoever grasps the quintessence of the Guru's instruction, him the Guru unites with the Lord's feet.
The Sikhs who have (san) thoroughly taken that teaching into their hearts — the True Guru has at once joined them to Hari's feet.
8WGV: Naanak kul = in the lineage of (Guru) Nanak (Dev ji). Nimmal = pure. Avtaryiu = has incarnated. Lahne sang hua = joined with Lahna ji.
Joined with Lahna ji, that is, Guru Angad ji, (Guru Amardas) has incarnated purely in Guru Nanak Dev ji's lineage.
Lehnaa, who became Guru Angad, and Guru Amar Daas, have been reincarnated into the pure house of Guru Nanak.
Lehna-Angad, along with Amar Dass was born in the immaculate House of Guru Nanak.
Through the company of the one who from Lahna became Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji, you have incarnated in the pure lineage — the order — of Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji.
6ES2: Taaran taran = the ship that carries across. Pa saran tua = (may I stay in) the refuge of your feet. Taran = ship. ||2||16||
O Guru Amardas ji! O ship that carries the world across! May I (stay) in the refuge of your feet in every birth. ||2||16||
Guru Amar Daas is our Saving Grace, who carries us across; in lifetime after lifetime, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||2||16||
Guru Amar Dass is the ship to ferry across the mortals. In birth after births, I long for the protection of yours feet.
O Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji! You are like a ship to carry beings across the world-ocean; so I am in the refuge of your (pa) lotus feet birth after birth. ||2||16||
G74Y: Pikh = seeing. Gur darsan = the vision of the True Guru (Amardas ji). Sikhah = to the Sikhs.
By having the vision of the True Guru (Amardas ji), the Sikhs (gain) chanting, austerity, truth and contentment.
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the Gursikh is blessed with chanting and deep meditation, truth and contentment.
Seeing the Guru's vision, the disciple of the Guru is blessed with the Lord's meditation, service, truth and contentment.
O True Guru ji! By seeing your Sikhs, virtues such as chanting, austerity, truth and contentment are gained.
ATDR: Parahi = fall. Ubarahi = cross over. Chhod = leaving. Likhah = writing. Jam pur kee = of Yama's city.
Those people who fall at (the Guru's) refuge leave behind the writing of Yama's city and cross over.
Whoever seeks His Sanctuary is saved; his account is cleared in the City of Death.
Whosoever seeks the Guru's refuge, he is emancipated and he is rid of the account of the city of death.
Those who fall at your refuge leave behind the writing that shames one in Yama's city and are saved from the world-ocean; meaning, they do no evil deeds.
PBZ4: Bhagat bhai = in the love of devotion. Ridai = in the heart. Uchrai = (Guru Amardas) remembers. Kartarai = the Creator.
(Guru Amardas) is filled in (his) heart with the love of devotion (to the Creator), and remembers the Creator;
His heart is totally filled with loving devotion; he chants to the Creator Lord.
His mind is filled with the Lord's meditation and affection and he recites the Name of the Creator Lord.
Because devotion and love fill your heart completely, you always utter only the Name of the Creator.
URN8: Gauhar = deep, profound. Dareeau = large-hearted, generous. Palak = in a moment. Dubantyah = those who are drowning.

The Guru is the river of pearls; in an instant, he carries the drowning ones across.
The Guru is the river of pearls and, in a moment, ferries across the drowning ones.
So, True Guru ji, you are bright of form like a pearl (gauhar), and by giving the ship of the Name you carry the multitude of beings drowning in the river of the world across in a single moment.
UJFS: Nanak kul = in the line of (Guru) Nanak. Nimmal = pure. Gun kartarai = the virtues of the Creator.
In the line of (Guru) Nanak (Dev ji), (Guru Amardas ji) has come as a pure incarnation, who utters the virtues of the Creator.
He was reincarnated into the House of Guru Nanak; He chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator Lord.
He was incarnated in the immaculate lineage of Guru Nanak and recites the praise of the Creator-Lord.
You have been born into the pure line, the tradition, of Sri Guru Nanak Dev ji, and you utter the virtues of the Creator.
VJEE: Jinh = the people who. Tinh = their. Parhar parai = goes away. ||3||17||
The people who have served Guru Amardas ji, their pain and poverty go away. ||3||17||
Those who serve Guru Amar Daas - their pains and poverty are taken away, far away. ||3||17||
They, who serve Amar Dass, the Guru, are rid of pain and poverty.
O Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji! Whoever has served your lotus feet has driven pain and poverty far away (parhar) and attained the state of liberation that is beyond (parai) all. ||3||17||
K8RU: Chit = in the mind. Chitvau = I think, I reflect. Kahau = I say, (that) I may say.
(O Guru Amardas ji!) I think in my mind that I should say (a) prayer; but I cannot even say it;
I consciously pray within my consciousness, but I cannot express it in words.
O my Guru, within my mind, I think of making a supplication before you, however, I can dare say it not.
O True Guru ji! I think in my mind of making a prayer before you, but I cannot even say it before you, because you are the knower of hearts.
GLJH: Sarab chint = all worries. Tujh pas = with you. Hau = I.
(O True Guru!) All my worries are in your care (that is, you alone carry all my worries); I look to the company of the holy (for support).
I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, for help.
I leave all my care to you and look to the saints congregation for help.
Although the thoughts of all beings are with you, that is, you know everyone's heart, I still beg of you to see the holy congregation; meaning, may I always have the company of saints.
K5X6: Terai hukam = (O True Guru!) in your will. Neesan = approval. Pavai = is received. Tau = then.
(O Guru Amardas ji!) If approval is received in your will, then I may serve the Master-Lord.
By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lord and Master.
In your will, I am blessed with the stamp of your mercy and then serve I my Lord.
O Guru Sahib ji! If by your command an excellent mark of destiny falls on my forehead, then I may serve your feet.
666K: Subh disat = with a gracious glance. Nam meva = the fruit of the Name. Karta = of the Creator. Mukh = in the mouth.
When the True Guru (Amardas) looks with a gracious glance, the fruit of the Creator's Name comes into the mouth (that is, is given to eat).
When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.
When, O Guru, you see me with the propitious glance, then the fruit of the Creator's Name is in my mouth.

So, O True Guru ji, now look on me with a good glance, that is, a glance of grace; then the Name of the Creator-Being enters my mouth as fruit (meva), meaning I chant the Name with my mouth; or, it tastes like fruit in the mouth.
NFF2: Agam = O unreachable True Guru, the form of Hari! Furmavahi = you command. Karan karan = the maker of creation. Agam = unreachable. Alakh = whose form cannot be described. Karan = creation. Karan = the root (of creation). Purakh = all-pervading.
O unreachable True Guru! O Guru, form of the indescribable Hari! O Guru Amardas ji, form of the Primal Cause! Whatever you command, that alone I say.
The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders, so do I speak.
Whatever is the command of the Unfathomable and Unseen Lord, who is the cause of all causes, that alone I recite.
O Primal Being, cause of all, unreachable by mind and speech, of indescribable form! Whatever you command, that I do.
B5G4: O Guru Amardas ji, form of the Maker of creation! As you keep me, so I live. ||4||18||
O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||4||18||
O Guru Amar Dass, you are the doer of all deeds; as you keep me, so do I live.

QEV6: Tat siu = with the Lord (who is the root of all). Tat = the soul. Gur = Guru (Amardas ji).

In deep meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, one's essence merges with the essence of reality.

7RQD: Pavan = the restless mind. Udant = wandering. Dhavai = runs.

That person brings lust, anger and the rest under control, and their breath (pavan), flying off (udant), that is, on leaving the body, does not run to other worlds; or, the mind that is restless like the wind and flies on flights of thought does not run for them.
2VKY: Des = in the land. Bujh = understanding, recognising. Beechar = wisdom.

I have been searching for the saints and have seen good many pious persons.

X4TM: Tapseeah = ascetics. E = these. Mukhahu mithe pandit = pandits sweet of mouth.

The hermits, Sannyaasees, ascetics, penitents, fanatics and Pandits all speak sweetly.
These solitarians, penitents and Brahmans are all sweet-tongued.
I have seen sannyasis and ascetics, and the pandits who speak sweetly with their mouths, these too I have seen in full.

I wandered around lost for a year, but no one touched my soul.

I listened to preachers and teachers, but I could not be happy with their lifestyles.
I have heard people say and preach, but seeing their way of life, I am not at all pleased.
I did hear the words of such talkers reciting the shastras, but no one who actually lived by (rahit) them pleased (khusee) me.
21LD: Chhod = leaving. Doojai = in duality, in something other than the Timeless Being, in maya.

ACDR: Dhramm dhanakh = the bow of dharam. Kar = in the hands. Rahio = is held [sic: the gloss reads 'rahio' for the line's 'gahio']. Bhagat seel = the gentle nature of devotees. Bhagat seelah = of the devotees' gentle nature. Sar = with the arrow.

MGUS: Bhai = because of keeping the fear (of Hari). Man = in the mind. Sabad gur = through the True Guru's Word.

Hari's Name, which takes one from fear to fearlessness, through the teaching of Sri Guru Angad Sahib ji: this you have planted as an unshakable lance in the battlefield of the mind.
A6RP: Apat = selfhood, ego. Bikhandio = has destroyed. Doot = enemies.

And has thus destroyed the five demons of lust, wrath, avarice, worldly love and self-conceit.
By that you have especially cut down, that is, destroyed, these five demons: lust, anger, greed, attachment and ego (apat).
BPMS: Bhalau = in the Bhalla family. Bhuhal = bhupal, king. Bhalau bhuhal = the crown of the Bhalla family. Tejo tana = O son of Tejbhan ji! Nripat nath = king of kings. Nanak bar = by the blessing of (Guru) Nanak.

Guru Amar Dass, the son of Tej Bhan, is the supreme person in the dynasty of Bhallas. Through the blessings of Guru Nanak, he is now the king of kings.
You are the son of the excellent (bhalau) king (bhuhal) Sri Tejomal ji. And how did you become a king? You became one by the blessing of Sri Guru Nanak Sahib ji, the king (nripat nath) of all kings.
XZYL: Bhan = say. Tai = you. Iv = in this way. Kar = doing. Dal = army. ||1||21||

Sall says truly, thisewsie, you, O Guru Amar Dass, has overpowered the enemy-hosts, waging a war.

EBTW: Ghanhar = clouds. Boond = drops. Ghanhar boond = the drops of the clouds. Basua = basudha, the earth. Romaval = a row of hairs. Basua romaval = the hair of the earth, its plant life. Kusam = flowers. Basant = of the spring season. Ganant = counting.
The drops of the clouds, the plant life of the earth, the flowers of spring: these cannot be counted.
The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the spring cannot be counted.
No one can count the rain drops falling from the clouds, the vegetation of the earth or the flowers of the spring.
The drops of the clouds (ghanhar), the hair of the earth (basua), which is the forests, grass and other plant life, and the flowers of spring cannot be counted.
4QJ9: Rav = the sun. Sas = the moon. Udar = belly. Gang tarang = the waves of the Ganga. Ko = who? Pavai = can find.

Who can know the limits of the rays of the sun and the moon, the waves of the ocean and the Ganges?
Who can know the limit of the rays of the sun or the moon and waves of the belly of ocean or of the Ganges?
Who can find the end of the rays of the sun and moon, of the belly of the ocean, of the waves (tarang) of the Ganga and, by implication, of all rivers? Meaning, no one finds it.
G5AD: Rudr = Shiva. Rudr dhian = with meditation like Shiva's (that is, sitting in completely unwavering samadhi). Bhalya = O Bhalya! With Shiva's meditation and the spiritual wisdom of the True Guru, says BHALL the poet, these may be counted.
Says Bhall, the poetical persons, with the Shiva's concentration, though man may be able to count them, however, he can know not the gnosis of the True Guru.

Just as there is no end to Shiva's meditation and to the True Gurus' wisdom; or, by the True Gurus giving the teaching of wisdom and by meditating like Shiva, Sri Kal, the poet, says: if anyone can sing of even those things mentioned above, that is, count them and find their end, then let them.
AZCF: Tohi = to you alone. Ban avai = suits. Upma = an equal thing. Teri upma tohi ban avai = you alone are like yourself; only by naming you as your own equal does the comparison fit. J = (the original word is 'jo'; here it is read 'ju'). ||1||22||
But O Guru Amardas ji, revealed in the Bhalla family! Your virtues cannot be described. You alone are like yourself. ||1||22||
O Guru Amar Daas, Your Glorious Virtues are so sublime; Your Praises belong only to You. ||1||22||
Sublime are yours virtues, O Guru Amar Dass. Your praise becomes only you.

O Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, who took birth in the Bhalla family! Your virtues cannot be told, because your virtues are endless. So your comparison suits only you; the meaning is that there is no other thing to which you could be compared. So you yourself are both the thing compared and the thing it is compared with. ||1||22||9||19||60||
54N6: Savaiye uttered in praise of Guru Ramdas ji.
Swaiyas In Praise Of The Fourth Mehl:
Saways in the praise of the 4th Guru.
Now praise of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib, the fourth Patshah ji, is uttered:
0LC9: The Timeless Being is One and is met through the grace of the True Guru.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By the True Guru's grace, is He obtained.
B8AM: Ik man = with a one-pointed mind. Niranjan = free of anjan (maya). Dhiavau = (that) I may meditate.
May I, with a one-pointed mind, remember the Timeless Being who is free of maya,
Meditate single-mindedly on the Immaculate Primal Lord God.
Single-mindedly, contemplate you your immaculate Lord.
Making the mind one-pointed, I meditate on the Pure Being.
20LS: Har gun = the virtues of Hari. Gavau = (that) I may sing. Gavat = singing.
By the Guru's grace may I always sing the virtues of Hari,
By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.
By the Guru's grace, ever sing you the praise of your God.
By the grace of that Hari, may I always sing the virtues of Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji.
B555: Man = in the mind. Bigasa = blossoming, bliss, joy.
And as I sing the virtues, may joy blossom in my mind.
Singing His Praises, the mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.
Singing the Lord's praise, the mind blossoms forth,
Singing the virtues of that True Guru, bliss (bigasa) will come to the mind.
QLZD: Satgur = O True Guru! Poor = fulfil. Janah kee = of the servant.
O True Guru! Fulfil the hope of me, your servant.
The True Guru fulfills the hopes of His humble servant.
and the True Guru, fulfills the desires of His slave.
O True Guru ji! So fulfil the hope of me, your servant.
RU6V: Sev = serving. Param pad = the highest state, the highest rank. Payau = has attained (Guru Ramdas ji, who).
(Guru Ramdas ji, who) by serving the Guru (Amardas ji) attained the highest state,
Serving the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained.
Serving the True Guru, the mortal attain the supreme status,
By serving Sri Satgur Amardas Sahib ji, you have attained the supreme state.
PXW8: Abigat = unmanifest, the unseen Timeless Being.
And has remembered the imperishable, unseen Hari,
Meditate on the Imperishable, Formless Lord God.
and meditates on the Imperishable and Formless Lord.
You have meditated on the imperishable, unmanifest Vahiguru.
7ZNX: Tis = that (Guru Ramdas). Bhete = on meeting, on falling at his feet. Champai = clings. Daridu = poverty, want.
On falling at the feet of that (Guru Ramdas), poverty does not cling,
Meeting with Him, one escapes poverty.
Meeting with Him, poverty clings not to one.
O True Guru ji! On meeting you, poverty does not press down (champai).
97CA: The poet Kalyasahar sings the virtues of that (Guru Ramdas ji).
Kal Sahaar chants His Glorious Praises.
Kalshar recites the praise of Him.
Sri Kalsahar ji says: I utter (jampai) your virtues.
1Q9F: Jampau = I chant. Bimal = pure. Sujan = excellent. Jan kere = of the servant. Kere = of. Amia nam = the Name full of amrit. Ja kau = to whom (Guru Ramdas ji). Phuria = was revealed.
I sing the pure virtues of that excellent servant (Guru Ramdas ji), to whom the Name that gives spiritual life has been revealed,
I chant the pure praises of that humble being who has been blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
I recite the pure praise of the sublime person, who recites the Lord's Nectar-Name.
O brother! My companions! Chant the pure virtues of the Guru ji, the beloved of his servants (jan), to whom the amrit-like Name has borne fruit (phuria).
VP40: In = this (Guru Ramdas ji). Sabad ras = the joy of the Word. Nam niranjan = the Name of the Pure One. Ur = in the heart. Dharia = has enshrined.
This (Guru Ramdas ji), by serving (Guru Amardas ji), has gained the joy of the Word and enshrined the Name of the Pure One in his heart.
He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.
Serving Amar Dass, the True Guru, that Guru Ram Dass was blessed with the Lord's elixir and he enshrined the immaculate Name in his mind.
He says to his companions: O brother! This Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, by serving Sri Guru Amardas Sahib ji, has held the Name of the Pure One in his heart and gained the bliss of Brahm (sabad ras).
G0Z1: Rasik = lover, one who relishes. Gun gahak = customer of virtues. Chahak tat = one who longs for Hari. Samat = equal vision, seeing all with the same love. Sare = pool.
(Guru Ramdas) relishes the Name of the Timeless Being, is a customer of Gobind's virtues, loves the Timeless Being, and is a pool of equal vision.
He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handed justice.
Guru Ram Dass is the enjoyer of the God's Name, the purchaser of the Lord's virtues, the seeker of the Master's quintessence and the fountain of even-handed justice.
You relish Hari's Name, you take in (gahak), or buy, Gobind's virtues, and you see (chahik) the Essence (tat) with equal vision throughout the whole (sare) universe.
PK50: Thakur = thakur (a term of respect). Hardas tane = the son of Hardas. Abhar = not filled, empty. Bhare = the one who fills. ||1||
O poet Kalyasahar! Guru Ramdas ji, the son of Thakur Hardas ji, fills the empty pools (of hearts with the Name). ||1||
So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||1||
Says Kalsahar, the bard, Guru Ram Dass, the son of Thankar Har Dass, fills the empty tanks.

Sri 'Kal' the poet says: O Sri Guru Ramdas Sahib ji, son (tanai) of Hardas ji, the chief (thakur) or master! Those whose heart-pools were empty of love, you have filled with virtues such as love. ||1||
LUJY: Amia = of amrit. Amra pad = giving the immortal (unshakable) state. Amrit sarovar = pool of amrit. Sad = always.
(Guru Ramdas is) a pool of amrit (which) always stays full, (and from which) the springs of amrit that give the unshakable state are flowing.
The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.
From Guru Ram Dass proceeds the stream of Nectar and immortal status, and he is like a tank of ambrosia that is always filled up to brim.

In your court at Sri Amritsar ji, katha and kirtan, the streams of amrit that give the immortal state, are pouring forth, that is, flowing. The pool always stays full of amrit; or, your heart-pool always stays full of the amrit of the final truth, and from that pool the streams of teaching are pouring forth.
1JS1: Te sant = those saints (plural). Peevahi = drink. Karahi = do. Man = in the mind. Majan = bathing. Pub = of a past birth. Jinahu = who. Karia = have done.
Those saints drink (this amrit) and bathe in the inner self, who have done some service in a past birth.
Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathe their minds in it.
